title: The fourth consecutive Dirichlet eigenvalue ratio
summary: An unconditional Lean proof of the strict inequality lambda_5 / lambda_4 < C_N for every nonempty bounded connected open subset of Euclidean space of dimension at least two, with variational Dirichlet eigenvalues and the sharp Bessel-zero constant. No boundary regularity is assumed.

formalizes.title: A sharp bound for the fourth consecutive Dirichlet eigenvalue ratio

review.reason: Lean proof of an unconditional bound on the fourth consecutive Dirichlet eigenvalue ratio.
